I will say this for S5E08: It did something that I thought all Television shows and movies had lost the power to do.

It made me feel fear towards Zombies.

I've been desensitized to the living dead for years, I haven't been genuinely afraid of them since I watched Dawn of the Dead when I was 12. I've killed so many living corpses across so many mediums, and seen them used so often, that they've usually got about as much fear to them as any other mundane threat presented in a work of Fiction.

The Wights? Those fuckers had me squirming in my seat. They were rotten, mutilated, INSANELY FAST, and many were using weapons with a fair bit of skill for a frozen corpse. Watching the Wight Kids rip into the Wildling Mother? Watching them just avalanche over the barricade? And then watching their King resurrect all those corpses at once? Yeah, I was on the edge of my seat.

SERIOUSLY WELL DONE! Every one, from the actors, to the make-up artists, to the writers, to the cameramen, from the top down, you all deserve a pat on the back and a free beer!
